name: Raleigh Seamster
description: Raleigh Seamster’s PLACE19 session concerned storytelling with Google Earth. The programme identifies her as a Google Earth Outreach senior programme manager supporting Indigenous communities and records training at Indigenous Mapping Workshops in Aotearoa, Canada and Australia.
